retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban collage featuring a central portrait enclosed by a thick, hand-painted red border with distressed, scratchy white typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition where a central profile portrait is framed by a thick, vibrant red border with rough, painterly edges. The background consists of a desaturated, high-contrast urban collage, while the typography appears as white, hand-scratched lettering that overlaps the red frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject framed by a dominant red graphic border
High-contrast portrait against a busy, textured background
Scratchy white text layered over a solid red frame
Juxtaposition of clean red color against desaturated urban textures
coreInvariants: Thick, hand-painted red rectangular frame with irregular edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central profile portrait, medium shot, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick, vibrant red border acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red frame, move to the central portrait, then follow the white text at the top and bottom edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with collage textures and graphic elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red frame contrasts with the low-saturation, high-contrast background imagery.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters appear to be scratched into the surface

composition.position: top and bottom edges of the red frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single distressed hand-lettered style used for all text elements to maintain grit.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-painted, aggressive energy of the original.
Provides the necessary raw, textured edges.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a desaturated urban collage background with a central profile portrait of a person wearing a red cap. Overlay a thick, vibrant red hand-painted rectangular frame with rough, distressed edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom white hand-scratched uppercase lettering at the top and bottom, overlapping the red frame with a slight black drop shadow for legibility.

verificationChecks: Is the red frame thick and painterly?
Is the text white and scratchy?
Does the text overlap the red frame?
Is the background a desaturated urban collage?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red frame has visible brush stroke textures.
Verify the white text looks etched or scratched, not typed.
Check that the background collage remains desaturated to let the red pop.
Confirm the central portrait is clearly framed by the red graphic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Collage + Painterly Red Frame + Scratched White Typography
